vb_textbox.text: Previous contestant said to me the gnomes are grouped by two colour groups. How they wrked that out i dont know. Earthy colours orange/green/yellow/brown and less natural colours purple/red/blue how they would have worked this out i dont know. Apparantly the purple/red/blue gnomes yeald more mushrooms so should be used on the x5 count when it is given. They also said use the x1 count on the other colours. Although i found this to be pretty random as i used the x5 count on the so called earthy colours as well and got more mushrooms from it. So i think it is to be fair pretty random. The best thing i could say was dont forget to press the space bar i did a few times so if you do you waste your turn and get no mushrooms. Dont press the space bar until the basket appears otherwise it doesnt register.
